# Gist me

> Gist me is a localized social micro-blogging and community spotlight platform for Ghanaian Senior High School (SHS) students and youth culture.

## About

Students can discover school communities, share short public gists, explore trending conversations, publish anonymous confessions, send shoutouts, and find promoted Spotlight posts. Community reporting and moderation features support safer participation.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://www.gistme.online/): Main community feed.
- [Explore](https://www.gistme.online/explore): Search public gists, students, and school communities.
- [Trending](https://www.gistme.online/trending): Trending community conversations.
- [Spotlight](https://www.gistme.online/spotlight): Active promoted gists.
- [Privacy information](https://www.gistme.online/privacy): Privacy overview.
- [Terms of use](https://www.gistme.online/terms): Platform and community guidelines.

## Audience and scope

Gist me focuses on Ghanaian SHS and TVET school communities, student life, school events, sports, WASSCE and NSMQ conversations, and Ghanaian youth culture. User-generated content may change frequently and should not be treated as official school information.
